parameters.description_en:
The quota dimensions. A quota dimension is an attribute of a quota. The combination of Dimensions and QuotaActionCode uniquely identifies a quota.

> This parameter is required for some Alibaba Cloud services. To query the supported quota dimensions, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The `Requisite` parameter in the response indicates whether a dimension is required.
parameters.description_zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度（Dimensions）+配额ID（QuotaActionCode）确定唯一的配额项。
> 部分云产品维度必填。您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填。

element_fields.description_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> Specify `Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` at the same time. The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud service supports. To query the supported dimensions, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The value of N is the number of elements in the returned array.
element_fields.description_zh:
配额维度的Key。

> `Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N。
